name: Island Carpet & Tile Cleaning
description: At Island Carpet & Tile Cleaning we know you have a few choices in the Gulf Shores area for someone to come clean your home or office. What sets us apart is our exceptional service, and our dedication to getting the job done right. We offer carpet cleaning and protection, tile & grout cleaning and sealing, pet odor and stain removal. We also provide mattress cleaning & sanitizing, furniture & upholstery cleaning and Auto/ RV interior cleaning services. We use the latest state of the art cleaning equipment for best results, and to be less invasive in your home or office space. We believe offering you the newest and most advanced equipment and cleaning technology will always provide you with the best results. We also offer several option choices in equipment, cleaning and sanitizing agents, including green certified supplies, and of course we always offer the option of working around your schedule. When you choose Island Carpet & Tile Cleaning, you get to choose what options work for you and your family. The last reason you should choose us to clean your home or office, we will always give you the customer service you deserve and expect. You are the reason we are here, and getting everything perfect, getting your job done right, is our only priority! Island Carpet & Tile Cleaning offers excellent customer service to each customer. We look forward to helping you if you live in or around the Gulf Shores, AL area. Our team is standing by to make sure that you are completely satisfied with the work that we provide. We offer a variety of different services that you can count on. Our carpet cleaning is done to the highest standards so that your home looks and smells amazing. We also offer tile and grout cleaning. If you have pets, we offer pet odor removal. We also provide upholstery cleaning in your home, auto or RV. All of our technicians are all certified by the Institute of Inspection Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC), a non-profit organization that sets standards for cleaning and restoration companies. The certification involves specific training, continuing education and access to an online library, which means our technicians know the most effective techniques to care for your home. We have pledged to perform services in these areas with skill, honesty, and integrity in order to provide our customers with the highest degree of professionalism possible. When you are interested in professional services from a company that cares about your unique needs, choose us. We will work hard to make sure that you are satisfied with all of our services. It is our goal to make you a happy customer by providing top-of-the-line services.
